status: root accepted design direction; unregistered art proposal only
decision: Two-stage Psychic/Flying acoustic route-memory bat: Echolet evolves into Sonatlas at level28.
recommended_type_reason: Psychic and Fairy tie for the second-lowest regional count13, after Dragon11, but the new Fairy release already addressed Fairy. Psychic has no active regional user with Speed100+, and current Flying has no SpA100+ member. Psychic/Flying fills both a unique regional pair and a fast special-attacker/support role. This is a regional gap; returning native Natu/Xatu already use the pair.

alternatives_rejected.reason: Electric15 is low, but already has4Speed100+ users and6SpA100+ users. Buoyostic/Paddarray already own electrical remote sensing; a radar bat would duplicate those themes.
Hibernation does not make a bat an ice animal. Ice19 and existing Ice/Psychic4 already cover winter perception.
Ghost15 has8SpA100+ users; spooky echoes overlap existing loon/ghost roles without repairing fast Psychic availability.
Dark23 is already common and the pair already has3regional species, including aggressive goose/silo bird roles.
Dragon11 is the lowest count but neither anatomy nor regional ecology supports forcing a dragon theme. Strong type labels alone are not a concept.

family_theme: Northern long-eared bat, echolocation and remembering a route through winter. A youngster wraps its wing membranes into two listening pockets; the adult unfolds them into three-rib sensory fans whose broad path-like folds focus echoes. It stores the remembered shape of a forest-to-cave route as Psychic impressions.
growth_read: Closed small echo pockets → long folded listening ears plus broad open map-fan wings; a timid local listener becomes a fast pathfinder. Size, wing plan, ear depth and exposed anatomy all change together.

species.name: Echolet
species.anatomy: A compact true bat with two large cup ears, an exposed short muzzle, two separate visible eyes, two wing-arms and two tiny hind feet. Each partly folded wing forms one broad concave listening pocket; the cupped tail membrane is a single lower scoop. The shoulders stay visible instead of disappearing into an undifferentiated round cloak.
species.secondary_theme_visible: One broad bracket-shaped ridge inside each ear and the tucked wing pockets look like two incomplete remembered paths. These are grown sensory folds, not printed maps or equipment.
species.front_sprite: 34–40 native pixels tall inside56x56; asymmetrical partly open wing pose lets one clear pocket read beside the face. Broad ear openings, white eye windows with separated black pupils.
species.back_sprite: Independent48x48 close rear of two cup-ear backs, neck and upper folded wing roots; lower body/tail cropped. Rear has no false face.

species.name: Sonatlas
species.anatomy: A larger alert bat with the same two ear cups now long and deeply folded. Its two wing-arms open into broad membrane fans, each built around exactly three major finger ribs. Two large stepped fold bands across each membrane form an open path-shaped pattern; small hooked thumbs remain attached at the wing wrists. A true short-muzzled face sits between the ears and above the cupped tail membrane. Two hind feet remain small; no extra forearms, second wing pair, feather crest or dragon tail.
species.secondary_theme_visible: The juvenile two closed listening pockets unfold into a pair of wide echo-map fans. By changing the spacing of its finger ribs it focuses returning echoes, while Psychic memory preserves a route between hibernation seasons. The stored memory is fantasy, not a claimed bat ability.
species.front_sprite: 50–54 pixel-wide native silhouette inside56x56, with raised arched wing roots and lowered outer fingers. The face and ear openings remain large; three broad ribs per wing, two simple fold bands, no fine mesh/map texture.
species.back_sprite: Independent48x48 close upper-rear portrait showing enlarged ear cups, nape and near wing shoulders; wing tips and all lower body cropped. Do not shrink the entire broad frontal wingspan into the back box.

battle_role.role: Fast, frail special scout and disruption/support; Psychic STAB is the mature damage anchor, Flying supplies Ground immunity and mobility.
battle_role.restraint: Final480BST, Attack45/Defense60, no ability, no boosting custom mechanic. Five common2xweaknesses make switching in risky. Psychic immunity on Dark types remains meaningful in a roster with23Dark species.
battle_role.abilities: NONE; do not introduce a new echolocation/hibernation ability.
battle_role.existing_move_token_check: All proposed native level tokens already occur in authored profiles. Reflect remains a level-up move. Reflect/LightScreen were removed from TM/HM suggestions after actual Crystal TM-table validation; neither is a native Crystal TM.
battle_role.flying_damage_gap: Gust40 is special in the actual modern-move-split catalog; WingAttack is physical. No ordinary strong special Flying move is present among the frozen19extension moves. Aeroblast is native special but should remain a legendary signature rather than solve this ordinary bat. Mature native-only output therefore leans on Psychic, not a fictional powerful Flying STAB.

future_only_move_recommendation.reason: Existing native FLINCH_HIT already powers imported IronHead, so no new battle mechanic is required. A later approved move addition could provide the missing real special Flying STAB. With Speed115 its flinch pressure matters; do not add boosting mechanics.
future_only_move_recommendation.status: proposal only; absent from current270move pack; requires separate implementation, animation and engine tests

habitat_proposal: Nighttime forest edges and a fictional quiet cave-mouth side path; early/midgame Echolet availability could make Psychic accessible before the faster end-stage. Soudan/Mystery Cave are grounding references, not claims of existing authored encounters or a request to add mine machinery.
nonduplication: No bat is currently present among active species. Names are unique across all313source species, including inactive records.
Keeps actual two-arm membrane flight and a cupped tail, distinguishing it from bird wings, samara squirrel gliding and butterfly wings.
Echoes create spatial route memory, not Reverloon’s duplicate ghost silhouettes.
No resurrection of retired Hushuff/Scatacomb: no stone body, cave-hall torso arches, palm ears, musical performance or secret-knock theme.
Avoid Paddarray/Buoyostic sensory machinery: no antenna array, radio mast, glowing screen or electrical pulses.
sprite_feasibility: Four flat inks per species with fixed black/white, independent stage colors, continuous black outer contours and broad internal clusters. Three ribs/two fold bands maximum per adult wing fit native56front geometry. Draw real eye windows as multi-pixel white islands with black pupils; no gradients, transparency, fine cartography or post-conversion invented pixels. ImageGen concept v1 and four native four-ink conversion candidates are saved; not registered.

primary_sources.supports: Northern long-eared bats use forest-tree cavities/crevices in summer and caves/mines for hibernation. Minnesota bats catch insects using cupped tail membranes and navigate through echolocation.
primary_sources.fantasy_extension: Sensory wing pockets and Psychic route memory are original invented anatomy/behavior.
